name: Morozov-CH Backpack Pyrotechnic Horizon
description: Comfortably carry vital gear with the RRS Morozov-CH backpack. This softshell bag is made with an advanced duraweave that's lightweight yet ready for all manner of industrial work. It also features several easy to access pockets and a plethora of straps to keep supplies secure and tight to your back. The Gold Horizon Edition was made specifically for the company's operations in Pyro during the 26th century.
